goal: Show finance leads how a rolling 13-week cash forecast works in Ledgerly.
audience: Finance leads at small companies who forecast in spreadsheets today.

outline.heading: What a rolling 13-week cash forecast is
keyPoints: How it moves forward one week every week
outline.answer: A 13-week forecast of cash in and out that adds a week as each week ends.

facts.claim: How far static forecasts drift in a quarter

outline.heading: Rolling forecast vs static budget
outline.answer: A rolling forecast is updated weekly; a budget is set once a year.

tldr: A rolling 13-week forecast keeps cash visible; Ledgerly updates it from your bank weekly.
angle: Ledgerly's own variance data across its customers, not a template.
